106:33.en: 「I can see the road to victory...!」

106:62.en: 「This is gonna be a big play!」

106:262.en: 「Sorry, but this is my job too...!」

106:369.en: 「Hold it against me if you want.」

106:439.en: 「All I ever got good at\nis this kind of thing...!」

106:583.en: 「Monster hunting is old hat to me!」

106:616.en: 「I'm no fan of a dangerous world...!」

106:774.en: 「Now get off Earth and go home!」

106:975.en: 「I've had my fill of military ways!」

106:1073.en: 「I just don't like\nterrorism as a method...!」

106:1124.en: 「Learn to earn an honest living, too!」

106:1227.en: 「Dealing with women is\njust not my forte...!」

106:1425.en: 「At this range, it's this one's turn!」

106:1778.en: 「I pay back what I borrowed, pronto!」

106:1889.en: 「Sell me a fight, and I'll buy!」

106:1920.en: 「Hold on! Let me have a go too!」

106:2021.en: 「Big sale, and I take the loss...!」

106:2054.en: 「For my friends, I'll do it for free!」

106:2242.en: 「You got me...\nTime to give credit honestly.」

106:2291.en: 「Out of energy...!?\nWhat am I, a rank amateur!?」

106:2581.en: 「I don't like being touched by others」

106:2855.en: 「Wish the Chief would make\ngear like this too...」

106:2931.en: 「I wanted to win without a scratch」

106:3048.en: 「Graze or not, a wound's a wound...!」

106:3171.en: 「Little things add up, as they say.\nGotta be careful.」

106:3247.en: 「Jeez, that's a bit rude of you」

106:3323.en: 「Picked a fight with the wrong one...」

106:3366.en: 「They say the worse it gets,\nthe sharper your nerves must be...!」

106:3614.en: 「So what! I can still do this!」

106:3655.en: 「A pro never throws in the towel\nuntil the final moment...!」

106:3708.en: 「The auto-balancer's gone...!\nSwitching to manual from here!」

106:3771.en: 「It's too early to go rafting\non the River Styx!」

106:3822.en: 「Maybe it's time to pay\nfor my wicked deeds...!」

106:3914.en: 「Oh boy...\nLike this is the time for that!」

106:4000.en: 「I don't like that mindset of\nmaking easy money!」

106:4111.en: 「I'll take you on...! Nice and long!」

106:4189.en: 「I'm a man who pays his dues...!」

106:4220.en: 「Just so you know,\nthis isn't some misplaced grudge!」

106:4271.en: 「I'm not cheap enough to\nskim the change!」

106:4388.en: 「I'll take the best part for once!」

106:4742.en: 「Drop out and my load gets heavier!」

106:5286.en: 「Do you get it!?\nI'm the one paying the repair bill!」

106:5345.en: 「Not good...\nI can't shake this bad feeling.」

106:5398.en: 「A big comeback from a pinch\nisn't really my style...!」

106:5502.en: 「Damn it!\nDying to clear my debt is too lame!」

106:5606.en: 「$$スコート・ラボ$$ $$次元獣$$ Buster. Beast trouble? Call now.」

106:5677.en: 「When I decide, I go straight in...!」

106:5749.en: 「If I've time to fret, I advance...!」

106:5788.en: 「Debts and fights never end...!\nWhat a cruel twist of fate!」

106:5841.en: 「As expected of the Chief.\nA tune just how I like it...!」

106:5921.en: 「This new $$ブラスタ$$ carries on\nthe souls of R and B!」

106:5976.en: 「This one's free of charge! Keep it!」

106:6062.en: 「If it's $$バアル$$ we're facing,\nI'll resist with all I've got!」

106:6111.en: 「I'm not carefree enough to quietly\nwait for annihilation!」

106:6164.en: 「Kill or be killed! No hard feelings!」

106:6248.en: 「I'm sick and tired of all this\ntalk about darkness...!」

106:6303.en: 「I'll take the $$赤い彗星$$ title down!」

106:6387.en: 「We know each other's moves!\nNo need to hold back!」

106:6446.en: 「Even a dam falls to an ant hole...!」

106:6481.en: 「A freak of a monster off the charts!\nI'll punch through one point!」

106:6647.en: 「If you've time to split hairs,\nlearn more about the world!」

106:6710.en: 「Force it is, just as you wanted,\nyou villain!」

106:6759.en: 「Bowing to money and violence\nisn't my style!」

106:6816.en: 「I'll send you fallen wretches\noff for good!」

106:6867.en: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$!\nI'll be there when you die!」

106:6924.en: 「Say hi to $$マリリン$$ in the afterlife!」

106:7084.en: 「This planet has no need\nfor any rulers!」

106:7135.en: 「No mercy for traitors, $$サルディアス$$!」

106:7250.en: 「$$クラヴィア$$! I'll stop you myself!」

106:7346.en: 「You came shooting, so you must be\nready to get shot, $$ギルター$$!」

106:7407.en: 「Move aside, $$尸刻$$!\nYou're not who I'm here for!」

106:7521.en: 「I'm not so good-natured that I'd\njust hand over what's mine!」

106:7586.en: 「Even if I lose as a Reactor,\nI won't lose the match!」

106:7649.en: 「We've both been singled out\nby cruel fate...!」

106:7698.en: 「Is a life of only hating people fun,\n$$バルビエル$$?!」

106:7753.en: 「Sorry, $$バルビエル$$...!\nI'm used to being hated!」

106:7859.en: 「$$尸空#pilot$$!\nI'll blow a hole in your void!」

106:7908.en: 「We dislike each other equally!\nLet's go all out, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

106:7969.en: 「The Supreme Commander herself?\nQuite the hard worker, huh!」

106:8047.en: 「No thanks to women with no modesty,\n$$エルーナルーナ$$!」

106:8210.en: 「Fought a $$次元将$$ before!\nDon't think you can take me!」

106:8267.en: 「Both you and $$ガイオウ$$ went\nabout it wrong from the start!」

106:8377.en: 「My $$スフィア$$ is mine!\nI won't let you do as you please!」

106:8479.en: 「A fox borrowing a tiger's might!\nWe're never gonna get along!」

106:8538.en: 「Let's see what the God-chosen\nelite can do!」

106:8589.en: 「My life is mine!\nI won't let you do as you please!」

106:8648.en: 「The culprit behind the universe's\ndistortion, talking so big!」

106:8740.en: 「I'm no kid who'll listen just\nbecause you say you're angry!」

106:8809.en: 「Tens of millions old, still a brat.」

106:8911.en: 「I'm appalled at my own bad eye for\npeople, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

106:8970.en: 「Being made fodder for your twisted\njoy? I won't stand for it!」

106:9037.en: 「I'll stop your outrageous ambition,\npuny human though I am!」

106:9102.en: 「Move, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nYou're in the way of the future!」

106:9250.en: 「I'll make it work with this too!」

106:10045.en: 「So this is my $$スフィア$$'s power.」

106:10410.en: 「Backing the young is an adult's job!」

106:10505.en: 「I'll help, so go easy on my debt...」

106:10579.en: 「Maybe I was born for this role...」

106:10783.en: 「I don't want to see more of us fall.」

106:10824.en: 「Quick, pick them off one by one!」

106:11082.en: 「Can't do a thing... I almost laugh.」

106:11123.en: 「If I can't pay it back,\nI make sure I can!」

106:11292.en: 「Dodge the hit, still take debt...\nIt's rough...」

106:11454.en: 「You lot are the same old\nidiots as ever...!」

106:11538.en: 「You're not all that good\nwith the $$スフィア$$s either!」

106:11679.en: 「Seems you can't grasp me either,\n$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

106:11972.en: 「Haven't had a cold sweat in ages...」

106:12007.en: 「Turn a pinch into a chance...\nThat's how I'd like it to go.」

106:12064.en: 「Focus your nerves...! While I live,\nthere's still something I can do...!」

106:12125.en: 「Those who panic die first...\nThat's the battlefield...!」

106:12219.en: 「I'm ready to die in a ditch,\nbut I refuse to leave debt behind!」

106:12297.en: 「So $$スコートＳＰ$$ can't outrun this one!」

106:12338.en: 「This is where you dig in, $$スコートＳＰ$$!」

106:12379.en: 「Sorry I'm such a pathetic partner,\n$$リ・ブラスタ$$...」

106:12430.en: 「I can't let anyone wreck\nthe Chief's masterpiece!」

106:12483.en: 「Damn!\nI knew, but they're one tough bunch!」

106:12536.en: 「Nice one, $$尸空#pilot$$!\nI'll admit you're the real deal!」

106:12589.en: 「It galls me, but\nyou use the $$スフィア$$s better than me!」

106:12642.en: 「I'm not about to be hunted by you,\n$$アサキム$$!」

106:12691.en: 「This power...! So it beats $$ガイオウ$$!」

106:12732.en: 「Don't play at being superhuman\nwith just this much!」

106:12781.en: 「Sloppy finish, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nIs this the time to gloat!?」

106:12838.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go?!」

106:12929.en: 「Agreed. Thank Super Robot Wars Z for lasting.」

106:13008.en: 「Finisher: talk! Stop being the quiet type!」

106:13053.en: 「Chin up. Let's get back to the game.」
